description: Auto-research session (ENPIRE contract): a confined agent session with its own station and sandbox writes and runs its own training scripts - reinforcement learning on the station with reward terms from the library, learning from the demonstrations, fine-tuning or post-training the candidates you hand it, or code as policy - evaluates its deliverables on the development starts and freezes its best. Guided by your `brief`. Its evaluations count as development evaluations and its finished training episodes as training episodes of the campaign (caps: evaluations, train_episodes).

costs.all: one session (hours, default 4); its evaluations and training episodes are charged to the campaign
